entities.name: Hamming
entities.how_described: 本集说它是演讲者 Suman Yu 创办的公司,专注语音智能体的可靠性与安全,监控着 10,000 个智能体,并在四月上线了红队测试产品。

evidence.quote: My name is Suman Yu, and I'm the founder and CEO of Hamming.

entities.name: 语音智能体 (voice agent)
entities.how_described: 本集的主线:能打电话、与真人对话并采取行动(连日历、CRM、预订系统)的语音智能体,正从演示毕业进入生产,但错误率高、被当成比犯罪更值得警惕的对象。

evidence.quote: And before working on voice agent reliability and safety, I worked at a company called Citizen out of New York.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: When I got started in voice agent reliability in early 2024, voice was just starting to work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: However, reliability is still the number one problem holding back most voice agent deployments at scale.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Or in the voice agent equivalent, it would be a drive-through that's deploying voice agents at scale like a Taco Bell or McDonald's.

entities.name: 可靠性 (reliability)
entities.how_described: 本集说可靠性仍是阻碍大多数语音智能体大规模部署的第一大问题,实际错误率接近 10%,声音自信自然但提供的信息常常是错的。

evidence.quote: And before working on voice agent reliability and safety, I worked at a company called Citizen out of New York.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: When I got started in voice agent reliability in early 2024, voice was just starting to work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: However, reliability is still the number one problem holding back most voice agent deployments at scale.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 红队测试 (red teaming)
entities.how_described: 本集说 Hamming 四月上线红队测试产品,实测约五分之一的智能体能被攻破,并建议给智能体跑 7×24 小时不间断的红队测试。

evidence.quote: And I think our new recommendation now is to run 24-7 red teaming for your agents, especially if you believe the cost of bad interactions can be rather large.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 跨对话分析 (cross-conversation analysis)
entities.how_described: 本集强调真正的新洞见藏在跨对话的模式里,而非单通电话;逐通话打分只能检查已知问题的一致性,最优秀的团队都花大量时间做跨对话分析。

evidence.quote: We're spending a ton of time on performing cross-conversation analysis, not a pattern on a single call, but across conversations.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 评估 (evals)
entities.how_described: 本集说团队从人工听通话起步,再用评分表扩大覆盖率,进而投资评估产品、跑 LM 作为裁判给通话打分;部署前测试(文本对文本或语音对语音)是对抗黑魔法仅有的真防御之一。

evidence.quote: To scale that up even further, you then end up investing in some evals product.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And I've highlighted different flavors of monitoring, per-call scoring, manual kind of evals, listening to conversations, and cross-call analysis.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And if you are deploying voice agents and want to validate whether your architecture or your evals are set up correctly, please come and talk to us.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 监控 (monitoring)
entities.how_described: 本集把全方位监控系统列为防御的第二支柱:逐次通话打分、人工评估、监听对话、跨通话分析,既监控智能体也监控用户是否对抗性。

evidence.quote: Identify, prioritize, impact size, understand the fix, execute, check, make sure it didn't break anything, and then continue monitoring.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Step two is to have a great monitoring system of all kinds.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
